eps.o: When Zola steals the Rescue-Webs Firetruck, he learns that being a hero isn't so easy.
When Symbie slimes the city, Team Spidey chases him to his Slime Factory to stop him.
Spidey helps Mr. Fantastic when his hiccups cause him to change shapes.
After a potion turns them into kittens, Spidey and Spin must get creative to defeat Lizard.
Team Spidey must stop Green Goblin from controlling Zola with a remote.
Spidey, Ghost-Spider, and Mr. Fantastic must get a super-powered belt back from Black Cat.
When Sandman causes trouble on a mountain, Team Spidey uses their Rescue-Webs vehicles to stop him.
Rocket & Groot help Spidey save a stolen pufferfish from Lizard.
Aunt May's house flies away after Peter leaves Doc Ock's Octo-Floater in his room.
When Swarm sets her robo-flies on the city, Team Spidey uses their spider knowledge to stop them.
